summary.text: Cheryl Kagan is a Democratic member of the Maryland State Senate from District 17 in Montgomery County who has served since January 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She previously served in the House of Delegates from 1995 to 2003 and is vice chair of the Committee on Education, Energy, and the Environment.

paragraphs.text: Kagan was born in Washington, D.C., on July 2, 1961, graduated from Winston Churchill High School in Potomac, and earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Vassar College in 1983.
She did graduate study in public affairs at the University of Maryland, College Park, and served in the House of Delegates for District 17 from 1995 to 2003.

She was then executive director of the Carl M. Freeman Foundation from 2003 to 2007, executive director of the Education Fund of Americans for Democratic Action, and director of community engagement for the BBYO Mid-Atlantic Hub.
Kagan was first elected to the Senate in 2014 and has served since 2015.

She is vice chair of the Committee on Education, Energy, and the Environment and chairs its Environment Subcommittee, and she was vice chair of the Education, Health, and Environmental Affairs Committee from 2020 to 2023.
She served on the Commission to Advance Next Generation 911 Across Maryland from 2018 to 2022, and Ballotpedia says she established the national Nonprofit Legislative Caucus in 2020.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on June 23, 2026.
